name: gizza-ai/audio-reverse
summary: Play an audio clip backwards, optionally joined with the original

tool.description: Reverse an audio clip so it plays backwards (ffmpeg areverse) — sample-exact, no pitch change. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). mode selects what to write: 'reverse' (default) is the clip backwards; 'forward-reverse' plays the original then its reversal; 'reverse-forward' plays the reversal then the original, which is how reverse-cymbal risers build into a downbeat (both combined modes are roughly double the input length). Output is re-encoded to mp3 (192 kbps), wav, ogg, flac or m4a. Input up to 10 MiB; embedded album art is dropped. To reverse only part of a clip, trim it first with trim-audio.

format.description: Output audio format. Default mp3 (192 kbps); wav and flac are lossless.

mode.description: What to write out. 'reverse' (default) = the clip backwards. 'forward-reverse' = the original then its reversal. 'reverse-forward' = the reversal then the original (the reverse-cymbal swell into the downbeat). Both combined modes are about twice as long as the input.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
